websocket_listener._comment: Root-only shared physical WebSocket listener. Child contexts and wrappers configure only logical paths; wrapper processes receive BRIQUE_WS_ADDR and BRIQUE_WS_URL automatically from the engine.
websocket_listener._wrapper_auth_note: required (also the engine default): a wrapper connection must carry the per-launch secret the engine puts in BRIQUE_WS_URL (ws://addr/k/<secret>); anything else gets 404. optional is reserved for explicit local development.
websocket_listener._origin_note: Browser origin policy. By default only same-origin pages and clients that send no Origin header (wrappers, tools) may connect. List extra web UIs in 'allowed_origins' (exact scheme://host[:port]); 'allow_any_origin': true disables the check and is not recommended.

config._comment: Logical route on the shared listener. The physical listener address is defined by communication.websocket_listener.addr.

reflexive._projection_note: Optional automatic maintenance of the meaning projection (0 or absent = off): projection_sync_interval_ms applies new/changed/deleted descriptors found on disk every N ms; projection_verify_interval_ms adds a slower pass that also catches in-place edits; projection_sync_on_edit (true) refreshes it right after any reflexive edit.* that changed a descriptor, in any context. On demand: meaning.update with {sync:true}.
